result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, so the January example gives Anna 2 and Bob 1. The related tests pass (`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest`, `QuarterPurchaseOrdersTest`, `LatestPurchaseOrdersTest`), including a new test for this case.

- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart07.java`**: `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` gets the `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` filter, the same one the quarter and weekday queries use. I also updated its Javadoc to say cancelled orders are not counted.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`**: added a status-taking overload of the `purchaseOrder` helper and a `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted` test that reproduces the example.

Nothing is committed.
